description: Paper abstract and RQ1 compare Naive GrepRAG to baselines.
Section 4.3.3 identifies keyword ambiguity as a reranking failure.
Section 6 discusses command generation overhead mitigation.
Identifier-oriented query families shape the proposed retrieval plan.
Generic keyword failures shape query constraints and verification.
Fragmentation motivates snippet merging and context budgets.
GrepRAG post-processing motivates ranking and dedupe improvements.
